summary: os.tmpdir() re-reads env per call (probed); helper is test-only with zero src references; exit hook and 24h sweep are documented best-effort; rebased files only add the standard one-line import.

findings.detail: process exit hook skips SIGKILL; accepted documented limitation covered by 24h sweep.
Age-based sweep has no liveness check; >24h idle live scratch root could be swept. Very low probability at normal suite durations.
Conformance walk misses .spec.js; all current mkdtemp-using spec files verified to import the helper.
